text: Meridian Capital Partners is a two-billion-dollar asset manager whose quant team keeps hearing that quantum computing can already beat classical portfolio optimization.
Helena Vasquez wants a real answer: pick four of twelve candidate assets to maximize return minus risk, checked honestly against a trustworthy classical result.
A vendor pitch deck tells you quantum wins. A rigorous study checks that claim against an answer nobody can argue with.
Helena Vasquez sponsors this study. Soren Lindqvist builds the quantum side, with Dr. Amara Osei and Felix Nakamura keeping it honest.
Next: turning 'is this real or hype' into one precise, testable requirement.
